content: Determinism pitfalls when diffing generated JSON: unsorted dict iteration, timestamps, and randomized IDs cause spurious diffs; standard fix json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, indent=2) + stable derived IDs. pandas-specific: column-order differences and int64->float64 coercion after groupby produce byte-different JSON for identical data; dtype/serialization behavior differs across pandas versions (pin/record version). CI test pattern: run generation twice, assert byte-identical output. replicate/cog incident: random map iteration order caused spurious auto-PRs; fixed by stable sorting before serialization + determinism tests.
